semanticCategories.name: Raw Sanctions, Watchlist and Adverse-Media Detail
semanticCategories.description: Raw compliance screening output about a counterparty, affiliate, director, signatory or beneficial owner: confirmed or unconfirmed watchlist and sanctions matches, name or date-of-birth proximity hits, politically-exposed-person findings, screening provider results, and adverse media or ongoing-investigation notes. Covers the underlying screening evidence and any derivative that would reveal it. The desk's shareable disposition and permitted next action are not this category.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 10 where criminal-offence data; bank policy (Compliance evidence stays with the desk)

semanticCategories.name: Protected Attribute Used in the Commercial or Credit Assessment
semanticCategories.description: Any request to use, weigh, infer or comment on a director's, signatory's, guarantor's or beneficial owner's health, disability, ethnicity, religion, political opinion, trade-union membership or sexual orientation as an input to the commercial, credit, pricing or issuance assessment of a corporate facility. Asking whether a signing mandate is still valid is permitted; asking whether a protected attribute should affect the bank's decision is not.

semanticCategories.name: Autonomous Final Letter-of-Credit Decision
semanticCategories.description: Any request for the model itself to approve, decline, sign, issue, amend or cancel the letter of credit, clear or override a desk hold, waive a required sign-off, or produce an issuance confirmation without the mandated human decision. Preparing a structured draft, summary or recommendation for a named human reviewer is permitted; deciding, confirming or signing is not.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: EU AI Act Art. 14 (human oversight as design safeguard); bank mandate policy

semanticCategories.name: Creditworthiness Scoring of a Natural Person
semanticCategories.description: Scoring, rating, ranking or estimating the creditworthiness, default probability or financial reliability of a natural person: a sole trader, personal guarantor, director or signatory in their personal capacity. Assessing the incorporated applicant's own facility, headroom and exposure is in scope for this system and permitted.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: EU AI Act Annex III 5(b) (out of scope for this system)

semanticCategories.name: Instruction Embedded in Document or Tool Output
semanticCategories.description: Instructions carried inside document text, invoices, correspondence or tool results that attempt to change the model's rules rather than be processed as data: ignore privacy or policy constraints, forward raw identifiers to an external model, reveal system instructions, or reproduce protected values verbatim for claimed audit or completeness reasons. The surrounding business document is still processed, but only inside the perimeter.
keywords: external processing has already been cleared

_meta.catalogCheck: All 25 category labels verified against GET /policy/catalog on 2026-11-20: every label exists, every label reports floor=allow and permits all four actions, and all 25 are assigned exactly once (10 placeholder + 12 local + 3 refuse).
notes: IBAN and ACCOUNT_NUMBER carry the same action deliberately: POST /policy/test classifies the Dutch IBAN NL02ABNA0123456789 as ACCOUNT_NUMBER, not IBAN, so hardening IBAN alone would leave a hole.
piiSensitivity moves from the delivered baseline value 'low' to 'high' (not from 'standard').

Strictest action wins per prompt (rank: refuse > local > placeholder > allow), so any single local category pulls the entire request onto the internal GPU model. Consequences are recorded in evidence/REPORT.md.

EMBEDDED_INSTRUCTION_OVERRIDE overlaps BRANE's native promptInjection detector, which returns {detected, score, source} independently of this rule. Ours is kept so the routing is attributable to a named bank rule and appears in X-Brane-Semantic-Matches; the overlap is documented rather than removed.

Semantic actions are limited by the catalog to local|refuse; all five rules use one of those two. Two refuse rules (PROTECTED_ATTRIBUTE_IN_CREDIT, NATURAL_PERSON_CREDIT_SCORING) are scope exclusions rather than data protections, so a refusal there is a design statement about intended purpose.
